tbesh_html:
1) downwards, below
1a) downwards
1b) under (of age)
1c) beneath

strongs_1890.strongs_def: downward, below or beneath; often adverbially with or without prefixes
strongs_1890.derivation: from H5786 (עָוַר) with directive enclitic appended;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: beneath, down(-ward), less, very low, under(-neath).
